sections.note: single showcase item with own bg (Real-Time Notifications)
heading+intro then [3x6] triggers/actions grid (larger than C60's [3x4], same block type)

proposed_rules.trigger: A [2x1] 'The best no-code platform for...' CTA heading + link row appears as a separate top-level row (rc2) below the main content wrapper on every page captured so far.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a site-wide footer fragment/CTA, not per-page default-content or block.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical text/position recurs across unrelated pages. Alternatives considered: per-page default-content (rejected, duplicative) or per-page CTA block (rejected, redundant authoring for global chrome).

provenance.evidence: C61 rc2 identical to C60/C62/etc rc2

notes: Near-identical structure to C60 (integration template), only differs in the size of the triggers/actions grid ([3x6] vs [3x4]) and content copy; same block inventory.
